reviews.title: Bad picks and misleading
reviews.text:
Heard ok things so decided to subscribe. The “expert cappers” on this site are no better than asking your toddler for winners (might have better winnings honestly, or winning period). They love to show the persons record like 7-3 last ten, but it’s just misrepresenting numbers, I’m actually 10-0 in my last 10 winning bets. I would be surprised if any of their “experts” even have a winning record. Not to mention, several of the picks are also at odds of like -190 (and still lose 50%), or they jump on opening numbers and put picks out at like -2.5 when the line has already moved to -5.5. 
I understand betting is difficult. But this is just random ppl throwing spaghetti at wall to see what sticks, and being represented as though these “cappers” are using legitimate models and statistics to come up with bets. Do not subscribe, just go ask a toddle what they think the outcome of the game will be, it will produce more winners than this garbage.
